QUOTE: `schema` | Index stamped by a newer build than this process expects | Nothing through this process. A rebuild re-stamps the same newer version, so it stays stale; `data` ... `index(action='refresh')`; `code` ... Restart the MCP client, then `index(action='refresh', force=True)`
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer lists different remedies per axis, but it never states that the differing remedies are the reason a single flag wouldn't have sufficed. It also gives `code` a restart plus refresh, not a restart alone.
